name: Arsenal FC
description: One of England's most successful clubs, Arsenal play at the 60,000-seat Emirates Stadium in Holloway, North London.
travelTips: The Emirates is well served by Arsenal tube station on the Piccadilly line. Highbury & Islington station is also nearby.
matchDayTips: Book hotels in Islington or King's Cross for easy access. Avoid driving as parking is extremely limited.

name: Chelsea FC
description: A powerhouse of modern English football, Chelsea play at Stamford Bridge in Fulham, West London.
travelTips: Fulham Broadway tube station (District line) is steps from the ground. West Brompton is also walkable.
matchDayTips: The Kings Road and Fulham Broadway have great pre-match options. Book early for West London hotels on match days.

name: Liverpool FC
description: One of the most iconic clubs in world football, Liverpool play at the legendary Anfield in the north of the city.
travelTips: Regular shuttle buses run from the city centre on match days. The stadium is about 2 miles from Lime Street station.
matchDayTips: Stay in the city centre and take the shuttle. The Stanley Park area fills up fast on big match days.

name: Manchester City
description: Champions of England multiple times over, Manchester City play at the state-of-the-art Etihad Stadium in East Manchester.
hotelSearchArea: Manchester city centre, Etihad Campus, Ancoats
travelTips: The Etihad is on the Metrolink tram network — take the Ashton line to Etihad Campus stop.
matchDayTips: Manchester city centre has the widest hotel selection. The tram makes getting to the ground easy.

name: Manchester United
address: Sir Matt Busby Way, Old Trafford, Manchester M16 0RA
description: The most famous club in the world, Manchester United play at Old Trafford — the Theatre of Dreams — in Trafford, Greater Manchester.
hotelSearchArea: Old Trafford, Salford, Manchester city centre
travelTips: Old Trafford Metrolink stop is right next to the ground. From Manchester Piccadilly, trains run to Deansgate then tram.
matchDayTips: Salford Quays hotels are well-positioned. The Media City area is modern with good transport links.

name: Tottenham Hotspur
description: Spurs play at their stunning new stadium in N17, one of the finest football arenas in the world.
hotelSearchArea: Tottenham, Wood Green, Edmonton, North London
travelTips: Seven Sisters tube (Victoria line) then a short bus ride, or White Hart Lane overground station is walkable.
matchDayTips: For bigger hotel choice, stay in the West End or King's Cross and use the tube. Local options are limited.

name: Newcastle United
address: St. James' Park, Newcastle upon Tyne NE1 4ST
description: St. James' Park sits right in the heart of Newcastle city centre — one of the most atmospheric grounds in England.
travelTips: St James' metro station (Yellow line) is right outside the ground. From Newcastle Central Station it's a 15-min walk.
matchDayTips: City centre hotels are ideal — you can walk to the stadium. The Quayside has great pre-match bars and restaurants.

name: Aston Villa
description: One of England's founding clubs, Aston Villa play at the iconic Villa Park in the Aston area of Birmingham.
travelTips: Witton train station is right next to Villa Park. From Birmingham New Street it's a short train ride.
matchDayTips: Birmingham city centre has the best hotel selection. Witton station makes getting to the ground straightforward.

name: West Ham United
address: London Stadium, Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park, London E20 2ST
description: West Ham play at the London Stadium in the Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park, Stratford — a former Olympic venue.
travelTips: Stratford station (Elizabeth line, Central line, DLR, Overground) is a 10-minute walk from the stadium.
matchDayTips: Stratford has good hotel options near Westfield. The Elizabeth line makes central London hotels very accessible too.

name: Brighton & Hove Albion
address: American Express Stadium, Village Way, Brighton BN1 9BL
description: Brighton play at the Amex Stadium in Falmer on the outskirts of the city, set in the stunning South Downs.
travelTips: Falmer train station is right next to the Amex. Direct trains from Brighton station run on match days.
matchDayTips: Brighton seafront hotels are wonderful for a weekend trip. The Lanes area is great for pre-match food.

name: Everton FC
description: The Blues play at the historic Goodison Park — one of England's oldest major football grounds — in Walton, Liverpool.
travelTips: No direct rail to Goodison. Buses run from Liverpool city centre. Kirkdale station (Merseyrail) is walkable.
matchDayTips: Liverpool city centre is the best base. Everton and Liverpool stadiums are close together near Stanley Park.

name: Fulham FC
description: Fulham play at the charming riverside Craven Cottage on the banks of the Thames in West London.
travelTips: Putney Bridge tube (District line) is the closest station, about 10 minutes walk. Buses also serve the area.
matchDayTips: The riverside walk to Craven Cottage is one of football's great pre-match experiences. Arrive early to enjoy it.

name: Celtic FC
description: Celtic play at Celtic Park — Parkhead — one of Europe's most iconic and atmospheric football stadiums.
travelTips: Glasgow Central and Queen Street stations are about 2 miles from Celtic Park. Buses and the subway serve the area.
matchDayTips: Glasgow city centre has the widest hotel choice. The Merchant City is a great area with excellent bars and restaurants.

name: Rangers FC
description: Rangers play at the magnificent Ibrox Stadium in Govan — a stunning Victorian-era ground with a rich history.
hotelSearchArea: Glasgow city centre, Govan, South Side
travelTips: Ibrox underground station (Glasgow Subway) is right next to the ground. It's one stop from the city centre.
matchDayTips: The Glasgow Subway makes Ibrox very accessible from the city centre. Book city centre hotels for maximum flexibility.

name: Leeds United
description: Leeds United play at Elland Road, a fortress of a ground with one of the most passionate fan bases in English football.
travelTips: Regular shuttle buses run from Leeds city centre on match days. The ground is about 2 miles from the train station.
matchDayTips: Leeds city centre has excellent hotels. The city's nightlife and restaurants make it a great destination for away fans.

name: Sunderland AFC
description: Sunderland play at the Stadium of Light, a modern 49,000-capacity ground on the banks of the River Wear.
hotelSearchArea: Sunderland city centre, Stadium of Light
travelTips: Stadium of Light Metro station (Tyne and Wear Metro) is adjacent to the ground. From Sunderland station, it's one stop.
matchDayTips: Sunderland city centre hotels are the best bet. Newcastle is also reachable for a wider choice if needed.

name: Sheffield United
description: Sheffield United play at Bramall Lane, the world's oldest major football stadium still in use.
travelTips: Bramall Lane is within walking distance of Sheffield city centre and Sheffield train station.
matchDayTips: Sheffield city centre is perfect — it's walkable to the ground. The city has great food and pub culture.
